summary: Recently, harness self-evolution has emerged as an important paradigm for improving agent performance. Prior studies show that evolving the agent harness can effectively enhance agent capabilities without modifying the foundation model's parameters.
takeaways: Prior studies show that evolving the agent harness can effectively enhance agent capabilities without modifying the foundation model's parameters.
We find that existing approaches largely study agent evolution on a single task.
In practice, coding agents may need to handle multiple task types over time.
